correctness.rationale: Reconstruction from the published unrelaxed SAV equations yields an exact rational first-step map. For squared initial amplitude at least two, the map is globally objective-descending. For amplitudes below two, the exact same-energy crossing reduces to \(h\,d(u)\le2\) for steps no larger than one. A strictly concave d(u) has a unique positive maximizer, with \(d(u)<2\) for negative u, proving the global sharp constant and all equality cases. Linearization at either minimum covers every step above one; the explicit epsilon scaling establishes \(F(x^+)\sim1/(64\varepsilon^4)\) while \((r^+)^2\sim\var\(\varepsilon^2\)/16\). The package script checks exact rational algebra and witnesses, high-precision critical root and symbolic limits; sampled points are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The precise global one-step objective-descent threshold is a natural algorithm-safeguard invariant, fixed by a canonical double-well model and its positive auxiliary shift. The strict gap \(h_*<1\) exhibits a failure missed by local linear stability, and the unbounded objective-versus-auxiliary mismatch quantifies the physical importance of distinguishing true and modified energy. This is not just a cheap example of increase: all real initializations, the sharp boundary and equality cases, and an explicit severe scaling are classified without invoking downstream results.
